doc.title: Dan Wall and Adam Nussbaum interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe thanks the guests and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview

blocks.x: Well listen fellas, this has been great for me.
So we’ll look down the road to do it again, and when you’ve got a little more experience under your belt. A few more airports.
That’s it, no problem. No problem. Thanks.
